textureAllocations.scope: Actual upload-method command counts over all nonempty orthogonal manifests, both directions; not GPU timing.

nativePainting.scope: Warmed Node CPU color conversion on real Ultra images, excluding Canvas, GPU, decoding, network and browser input latency.

limitations: No browser FPS or user-device input-latency measurements.
Cold or evicted slices still require decoding; cached encoded data is not always decoded data.
CT-card work can follow the prioritized 3D update by one render/task opportunity.

Larger GPU allocations cause bounded interpolation rounding: at most 14 changed pixels per 289100-pixel native comparison, including one isolated near-threshold S-20-29 classification change. Source pixels and physical geometry are unchanged.
